description.narrative: Support to Justice Rapid Response who work to strengthen accountability for international crimes and serious human rights violations, with a focus on sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV) and crimes affecting youth and children. Ireland's funding supports the SGBV experts roster. Previous funding has been used to deploy a gender adviser to the Gambia’s Truth and Reconciliation Commission; to support an expert deployed to the Group of Experts on Yemen; to support deployment of a documentation expert to a CSO in Iraq that is investigating war crimes; to deploy experts to Rakhine state to support accountability efforts for crimes perpetrated against Rohingya women; and to deploy experts to assist with the provision of psycho-social support and pursuit of justice for victims of ISIL, including Iraqi children and Yazidi women. It is well established that the majority of SGBV victims in conflict are women; JRR’s work contributes to a gender-sensitive response to conflict and the empowerment of women as rights holders, thus linking closely with Ireland’s foreign policy priorities relating to the Women, Peace and Security agenda.
